potionRule.ExplosivePotion: Deal damage equal to potency to all enemies (base 10).
potionRule.Elixir: Choose any number of cards in your hand to Exhaust.
potionRule.AttackPotion: Choose one of three generated Attack cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.SkillPotion: Choose one of three generated Skill cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.PowerPotion: Choose one of three generated Power cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. You may skip the choice.
potionRule.ColorlessPotion: Choose one of three generated Colorless cards. Add potency copies of the chosen card to your hand (base 1); the chosen card costs 0 this turn. This choice cannot be skipped.
potionRule.StrengthPotion: Gain Strength equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.BloodPotion: Heal for potency percent of max HP (base 20%), rounded down when used; actual healing cannot exceed missing HP.
potionRule.HeartOfIron: Gain Metallicize equal to potency for this combat (base 6).
potionRule.DuplicationPotion: This turn, each of the next potency cards you play is played twice (base 1). Applies to any card type, not only Attacks; unused charges expire at turn end.
potionRule.BlessingOfTheForge: Upgrade all cards currently in your hand for this combat.
potionRule.FirePotion: Deal damage equal to potency to one enemy (base 20).
potionRule.PoisonPotion: Apply Poison equal to potency to one enemy (base 6). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.WeakenPotion: Apply Weak equal to potency to one enemy (base 3). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.FearPotion: Apply Vulnerable equal to potency to one enemy (base 3). Artifact can block it.
potionRule.EnergyPotion: Gain Energy equal to potency this turn (base 2).
potionRule.DexterityPotion: Gain Dexterity equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.SpeedPotion: Gain Dexterity equal to potency (base 5), then apply an equal Dexterity Down debuff that removes it at the end of this turn. Artifact can block the removal debuff.
potionRule.SteroidPotion: Gain Strength equal to potency (base 5), then apply an equal Lose Strength debuff that removes it at the end of this turn. Artifact can block the removal debuff.
potionRule.FocusPotion: Gain Focus equal to potency for this combat (base 2).
potionRule.BottledMiracle: Add Miracles equal to potency to your hand (base 2). A Miracle costs 0, gives 1 Energy and Exhausts; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.AncientPotion: Gain Artifact equal to potency (base 1). Each charge blocks one incoming debuff, including a temporary buff's removal debuff if it is applied afterward.
potionRule.RegenPotion: Gain Regeneration equal to potency (base 5). At each player turn end, heal for the current stacks, then lose 1 stack; healing restrictions and the HP cap apply.
potionRule.EssenceOfSteel: Gain Plated Armor equal to potency (base 4). It grants that much Block at player turn end and loses 1 stack when an enemy Attack causes unblocked HP loss.
potionRule.LiquidBronze: Gain Thorns equal to potency for this combat (base 3). It damages an attacker for that amount whenever you are attacked, even if the hit is blocked.
potionRule.DistilledChaosPotion: Play the next potency cards from the top of your draw pile without paying their energy costs (base 3). Enemy targets are random; normal card effects and play restrictions still apply.
potionRule.CunningPotion: Add upgraded Shivs equal to potency to your hand (base 3). Each Shiv+ costs 0, deals 6 base damage and Exhausts; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.PotionOfCapacity: Gain Orb slots equal to potency (base 2).
potionRule.LiquidMemories: Choose potency cards from your discard pile to return to your hand (base 1); they cost 0 this turn. If fewer cards are available, return the available cards; hand capacity applies.
potionRule.GamblersBrew: Choose any number of cards from your hand to discard, then draw that many cards. You may choose none; draw prevention and hand capacity still apply.
potionRule.StancePotion: Choose to enter Wrath or Calm. Wrath doubles Attack damage dealt and received; leaving Calm grants Energy under the current stance rules.
potionRule.FairyPotion: Passive: when lethal HP loss occurs, consume this potion and heal for 30% of Max HP (60% with Sacred Bark), rounded down with a minimum request of 1 HP. Cannot be used manually. Mark of the Bloom prevents this revival.
potionRule.SmokeBomb: Escape the current non-boss combat instead of winning it; no combat rewards are earned. Cannot be used against bosses or while the Spire Shield and Spire Spear surround you.
potionRule.FruitJuice: Gain Max HP equal to potency and request the same amount of healing (base 5). May be used outside combat; healing restrictions still apply.
potionRule.EntropicBrew: Consume this potion, then generate random potions to fill empty slots, including its freed slot. Potions already held remain. Sozu prevents obtaining the generated potions.
potionRule.SneckoOil: Draw cards equal to potency (base 5), then randomize eligible costs of all cards in your hand to 0-3. X-cost and negative unplayable costs are excluded.
potionRule.GhostInAJar: Gain Intangible equal to potency (base 1), reducing incoming damage and HP loss to 1 per instance while active.
potionRule.CultistPotion: Gain Ritual equal to potency (base 1). Gain that much Strength at the end of each player turn, including the turn it is used; it does not grant Strength immediately on use.
potionRule.Ambrosia: Enter Divinity this turn: gain 3 Energy and triple Attack damage. Return to Neutral at the start of the next turn.
potionRule.EssenceOfDarkness: Channel potency Dark orbs for each current Orb slot (base 1 per slot). Normal channel and evoke rules apply.
